title: Logs2Paper
description: This mod allows you to get paper by stripping logs. You can get 0 to 3 pieces of paper each log.
body:
This mod allows you to get paper by stripping logs. You can get 0 to 3 pieces of paper each log.

By using an axe and right-clicking on any type of log, you will get from 0-3 peices of paper.

This useful mod changes the game so that you don't have to wait for sugarcane to grow just to make paper.
